svg.title: Two Metrics in the P3 Basis
svg.desc: Ellipses a²+b²/3=1 and a²+3b²=1 in the coefficients of w=a u1+b u2; the circle a²+b²=1 is shown for comparison. The axes coincide; the coefficients along u2 are reciprocals.
